items.title: لطائف الإشارات
items.finding: Native DOC volumes are discoverable online, but the located 2000 critical edition requires edition/rights review before repository redistribution.

items.title: روح البيان في تفسير القرآن
items.finding: Native searchable text is available online; public-domain scans also exist on Arabic Wikisource and Arabic Collections Online.

items.title: مفاتيح الغيب المشتهر بالتفسير الكبير
items.finding: EPUB/MOBI editions are discoverable, while Arabic Wikisource has public-domain scans. Native edition redistribution rights must be verified before replacing OCR.

items.title: جامع البيان عن تأويل آي القرآن
items.finding: A fully indexed 25-volume edition with a linked Shamela text exists; the located critical edition is modern and should not be redistributed without edition-level rights verification.

items.title: الجامع لأحكام القرآن
items.finding: Arabic Wikisource has native readable text and export options including EPUB/MOBI/PDF. This is the strongest native-text replacement candidate.
